title: Penoid construction in gender dysphoria female-to-male (trans men)
summary:
The project includes the collection, consolidation and analysis of data regarding penoid reconstruction in trans men (gender dysphoria, transsexualism). Before the actual penoid reconstruction, in most cases (patient request) a clitoris penoid (so-called metaidoioplasty) is surgically created, whereby the urethra is already somewhat lengthened. The penoid reconstruction including urethra formation (and stiffening measure by means of erectile prosthesis) is performed in scheduled three operations at least three months apart and extends over a total period of one to two years. In addition to the scheduled three surgeries (flap grafting, soft tissue correction, implantation of an erectile prosthesis), additional surgeries may be required due to complications (e.g., fistulas, strictures). Retrospective study part: collection of medical data (see below) on the steps of penoid reconstruction already performed from the clinic's own patient records. Prospective study part:
Obtaining medical data on penoid build-up during ongoing treatment; this includes handing out questionnaires (see below).

interventions.name: Descriptive study / observational study in patients with gender dysphoria and medical indication for penoid formation using free neurovascular radial flap plasty in Chang design with ventrally applied full-thickness skin graft.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients with female-to-male gender dysphoria (trans male) with medical indication for penoid reconstruction.
Exclusion criteria:
Underage
